summary: uri options: unsafe_writes, required url, url_username/url_password for Digest/Basic/WSSE, and use_gssapi for Kerberos (no NTLM).
questions: How do I pass credentials to the uri module?

answer_card.title: uri url and credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
- `url` (required)
- `url_username` (alias `user`), `url_password` (alias `password`)
- `use_gssapi` (false): Kerberos/Negotiate via python `gssapi`; NTLM not supported
- `unsafe_writes`
